title: OpenEPCIS extension (permissive): benetag
description: Permissive capture schema for the https://ref.openepcis.org/extensions/product/benetag/ extension. Declares known terms as optional and allows additional properties, so events that declare GS1-Extensions benetag=https://ref.openepcis.org/extensions/product/benetag/ validate and capture. Generated from the module ontology plus its JSON-LD context; tighten per ontology for field-level validation.

authProfile.x-access-level-rationale: The profile describes the tag's file settings; needed by the verifier, not by the public.

benetag:authProfile.x-access-level-rationale: The profile describes the tag's file settings; needed by the verifier, not by the public.

authStatus.x-access-level-rationale: The verdict is the answer the scanner receives; it reveals nothing about keys or the chip.

benetag:authStatus.x-access-level-rationale: The verdict is the answer the scanner receives; it reveals nothing about keys or the chip.

benetag:readCounter.x-access-level-rationale: The read counter is a per-item scan history; for an owner with sales data it can become personal data of the buyer.

boundAt.x-access-level-rationale: Binding time is scan history of the item.

benetag:boundAt.x-access-level-rationale: Binding time is scan history of the item.

benetag:carrierType.x-access-level-rationale: The carrier product reveals the security level of the label; operational detail of the owner and its labeller.

benetag:diversification.x-access-level-rationale: Part of the authentication profile; key-management detail.

benetag:sdmFileReadKey.x-access-level-rationale: K_SDMFileRead is a secret key; whoever holds it can forge the SUN MAC. Sealed in the event, readable only by the verifier that holds the wrapping key.

benetag:sdmMetaReadKey.x-access-level-rationale: K_SDMMetaRead is a secret key; whoever holds it can forge PICC data. Sealed in the event, readable only by the verifier that holds the wrapping key.
